theme: Sparse clusters of very thin tall arching stalks with small rounded ember-seed tips, echoing the wiry glowing-tip plants in the asset reference. Some bare curved shoots, a few narrow side leaves, several quiet low stretches.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: CLOSE BACKGROUND PLANT BAND A, Cinderheart Caldera, transparent 2D side-scrolling game scenery.
Image 1 is the approved Cinderheart asset pack: match its thin wiry plants, small warm tips, charcoal/burgundy volcanic materials and hand-drawn soft painted shading. Image 2 is the existing close-background rock bands: match their subdued values and related rock bases, but this NEW band should be mostly TALL THIN PLANTS with small basal rubble rather than big rock mounds.
Create a very wide landscape 4:1 strip, connected low base along full bottom edge, several widely spaced clusters of thin TALL plants rooted in small low porous scoria stones. Sparse clusters of very thin tall arching stalks with small rounded ember-seed tips, echoing the wiry glowing-tip plants in the asset reference. Some bare curved shoots, a few narrow side leaves, several quiet low stretches.
Plants reach 80–90% of canvas height. Leave genuine transparent space BETWEEN stems and above the silhouettes. Thin elongated forms, not a dense solid hedge, not broad tree trunks or thick vines. First and last 10% width must contain only LOW rubble and little sprouts, with no tall stems touching side edges, so the strips can connect.
Opaque softly shaded dark plant bodies, not flat black silhouettes. Deep charcoal, muted burgundy/mauve stems, a restrained cool rim and occasional very dim copper ember seed tips. NO bright glowing bulbs, bloom, orange lighting, green foliage, moss, flowers, bones, crystals, architecture, large boulders, terrain platforms or scene backdrop. Lighting and detail dimmer and gentler than playable terrain. Fine dark contours, clean readable silhouettes, simple painted shading consistent with the pack. Full bottom attachment, no side margins, no labels, grids, watermarks or checkerboard. Transparent PNG production layer.
